areas.title: Hawker's Cove / Tregirls Beach
areas.purpose: Shows conditions in the outer Padstow-side section after low tide and helps link this area to the rest of the estuary survey.

areas.title: Daymer Bay
areas.purpose: Shows the outer bay area as the tide was still falling and gives context for the entrance to the estuary.

areas.title: Rock Beach
areas.purpose: Shows the central area close to low tide, when more of the estuary bed was exposed.

areas.title: Padstow Harbour Estuary
areas.purpose: Shows the Padstow-side harbour flats as the water started to return.

areas.title: Porthilly Cove
areas.purpose: Shows a key transition area where changes to bars and channels are easier to track over time.

areas.title: Old Town Cove
areas.purpose: Shows the upper estuary later in the tide cycle and helps record how conditions changed further inland.

areas.title: Slate Quarry
areas.purpose: Shows how the mid-inner estuary was exposing before low tide.

areas.title: Wadebridge
areas.purpose: Shows early Day 2 conditions while the tide was still falling and more water remained across the estuary.
